[i]Life is complicated. I killed people. Smuggled people. Sold people. Perhaps here...things will be different.[/i]"[/quote]
Mehmed takes a drag on his Ilalburo Lights by the window of his cousin's apartment. The smoke is caught in the sunbeam, he gives thanks that his cousin does not witness this act. He remembers his cousin in the selfish moment of thanking. The young man was a fervent hater of all illicit substances. Ironic, considering Mehmed's line of work. But his cousin did not question where his half the rent came from, he was only thankful it was not coming out of his desperate wallet.

Mehmed threw the cigarette out the window, concrete below would prevent a fire, [i]probably[/i]. He stretched and groaned. He didn't really want to be here, but what're ya gonna do? Mehmed briefly stopped in the bathroom, brushing his teeth aggressively before he took his leave of the apartment and made his way outside to the streets of his new city. He sought a convenience store, he had need of gum. There was no sense in being all secret about the smoking if his breath tasted of ash.

Romariian News Network 
--------------------------- 
Muslim Militia Emerges and clashes with Geranora and Warszawa separatists. 
---------------------------

Early this morning, hundreds of Geranoran and Warszawan separatists stormed the streets of Lil Warszawa and Lil Geranora, causing widespread damage estimated to cost several hundred Aerums.

However, in what officials are calling a bad timing situation, a Muslim militia identifying itself as "al-Jamahiriyah al-Islamiyyah al-Romariia" (which is Arabic for "The Islamic Jamahiriya of Romariia") emerged just as the riots began to intensify and worsen.

The militia, immediately after revealing itself, launched coordinated attacks against both the RISF and the separatists, effectively stopping the riots, as the RISF and the separatists stopped fighting, but instead, turned them into a large-scale urban battle against the muslim militia.

Initial reports estimate that over 1,000+ people have been killed, with approximately half of the casualties being RISF personnel. Thousands more have been reported injured or displaced as fighting spread across multiple districts.

Authorities have described the situation as rapidly deteriorating, with control over several neighborhoods now unclear.

Following the incident, the Government issued a public statement discouraging Muslim citizens from joining or supporting the militia, stating that such actions would deeply upset Marietta," whose location is still unknown.
However, more recent reports have shown that the statements have not stopped many Romariians from joining the militia.

At the same time, the Christian militia (which controls most of the western parts of the country), the Christendom of Romariia, has intensified its displacements of muslims within territories under its control, with the group claiming it is protecting Christians from suffering the same fate as those in Lil Geranora and Warszawa.

In response to the growing instability, the Government has formally requested cooperation from Arelia, proposing joint patrols in regions of both nations near the former territories of Wielka Warszawa and Geranora to contain the spread of violence and prevent cross-border escalation.

Experts warn that the sudden emergence of another armed faction, especially a religious one, combined with ongoing separatist unrest, existing militia activity, and international pressure, marks a dangerous turning point in the crisis.
[/spoiler]

[spoiler=meanwhile with Mario, a few hours ago]
(note: yet again another omnipotent scene)
Mario was sitting at his desk, sweating a lot. Why, you may ask? Basically, he just found out that no matter how much he would fulfill the Ultimatum, his country would still get invaded. But hey! At least Wuloosya called him president instead of the monarch!

"Mama miaa... Hey, at least they called me president instead of monarch. Why would they call me that?"

"Because this country was a constitutional monarchy until you got bored in 2015 and turned it into a democratic republic," said Luigi, who came out of nowhere.

"MAMAMIA!" shouted Mario in shock, "Luigi! don't scare me like that!"

"By the way, Mario, have you read the response from Wuloosya? I told you your response was too harsh!" said Luigi

"Yeah, about that..."

"Anyways, the riots in Lil' Warszawa and Geranora have stopped!" continued Luigi.

"How?" asked Mario

"A Muslim Militia formed, and they are killing everyone, so the separatists and the RISF decided to stop fighting each other and work together!"

"Bruh, 2 religious militias?!" said Mario, "by the way, I'm still planning to send that one soldier who swapped tear gas with mustard gas to the international forum, do you have any in-"

"he just surrendered himself at 11 pm," Luigi cut off abruptly.

"Oh, ok, get him prepared to be sent," said Mario.

"Wouldn't the International Forum expect you to join him?" said Luigi

"Luigi, the moment I lift my finger out of this nation, I can predict that this nation will collapse!"

"Good point, by the way, I think I should send a request to Arelia."

"What request? and why you, the one who will send it?" asked Mario

"I want to request them for a joint military patrol in both our and theirs Warszawa and Geranora, because you know, they also have more than half of former Warszawa and Geranora, also I would send it because you suck at international diplomacy."

"Aw, man..." whined Mario

[i]-Later-[/i]

"There we go!" said Luigi, "time to send it!"

From: Vice President of Imperium Romae Marii, Luigi Mario
To: Whoever is in the Arelian Government.

We are deeply concerend on the rise of separatist and militant activity in Lil' Warszawa and Lil' Geranora, but we are more concerend on these groups seeping into Arelia, potentially causing things to worsen.

To prevent this possability to happen, we have strongly urge that you sign a joint military patrol with us in former Warszawa and Geranora, particularly on the border, to prevent further separatists and militant activity, and save stability in these areas.

If you disagree with this, we will understand.

From,
Vice President of Imperium Romae Marii, Luigi Mario.
[/spoiler]

Romariian News Network 
--------------------------- 
Anti-Wuloosyan riots erupt in Isle Duckie and Isle Long.
---------------------------
The Isle Federal Group, long considered one of the most stable and peaceful regions of Imperium Romae Marii, has experienced its first major wave of unrest since its integration into the nation.

Earlier today, the first-ever riots broke out across Isle Duckie and Isle Long, driven not only by anger but by growing fear among residents following recent statements by Wuloosya regarding invasions on Romariia's "Colonial" Islands.

Many residents in the federal group believe these statements directly refer to the southern islands of the Isle Federal Group, particularly Isle Duckie and Isle Long, due to their geographic isolation from the mainland Romariia, their location near Vespurias, and their status as former colonies before their integration into Romariia in the 2010s.

Protesters have been seen taking to the streets, expressing fears that their islands may become the first targets of a Wuloosyan military operation. Demonstrators have been seen carrying anti-Wuloosyan signs, with some calling for the execution of the Wuloosyan leadership and the destruction of Wuloosya. Some other demonstrators have been calling for the reclamation of Xahu Island, which the government has recognized as a part of Yulandburg.

Unlike unrest in other parts of the country, these riots have been small and appear to be largely fueled by panic and fear rather than organized political movements.

The situation has further complicated the incomplete construction of the Inter-Island Bridge, a major infrastructure project intended to connect Isle Duckie and Isle Long that started back in 2020. Construction has stalled in recent years due to shortages of materials, lack of investment, and now increasing international pressure.

Officials have issued public statements urging citizens to remain calm, emphasizing that no invasion has yet occurred. However, the Romariian Navy and the coastal guard have been dispatched to Isle Long and Isle Duckie for protection against Wuloosya, which has increased fear in the 2 Islands.

Meanwhile, the third and northern island province, Tres Isole, remains largely unaffected. Officials conclude that the province is more stable than the southern islands due to the province being a part of Romariia for much longer, closer to the mainland, and having stronger economic and logistical connections.

Experts warn that with the impending doom of a Wuloosyan invasion, the last stable regions in Romariia might dissolve out.

[/spoiler]

Romariian News Network 
--------------------------- 
Mass fighting in Yoshiland as Multiple Factions clash amid a 2nd Animist Revolt.
---------------------------
The Yoshiland Province, last known for the April 12th incident, has once again descended into large-scale violence, as a second Animist revolt has erupted; however, this revolt has rapidly escalated into one of the deadliest multi-sided conflicts in Imperium Romae Marii since the April 12th incident due to other factions, and nature being involved.

The unrest began this evening, when thousands of Animist protesters took to the streets, demanding full independence and religious freedom. Unlike the first revolt, this uprising was more organized, with more animists being armed and strikes against government buildings.

The RISF was deployed shortly after the uprising began. Officials confirmed that, due to international pressure following the April 12th incident, RISF units were deployed with reduced equipment, and no chemical agents were used.

However, within hours of the RISF deployment, both the Communist Defense Force (CDF) and the Romariian Ordnungstaat entered Yoshiland, transforming the province into an active multi-faction battlefield. Experts believe both groups sought to exploit the instability to expand their territorial control and influence.

However, amid the fighting, a much more destructive force further worsened the situation; a large number of Yoshis, the national animal of Romariia and native to the region, were reportedly agitated by the explosions, gunfire, and destruction. Witnesses describe sudden mass movements of Yoshis across both urban outskirts and open terrain, forming what many have described as uncontrolled stampedes.

These stampedes have disrupted multiple engagements in the conflict, forcing temporary withdrawals by several factions, though fighting has not fully ceased.

Recent estimates suggest that over 5,000 individuals have been killed so far, the majority consisting of CDF fighters, Ordnungstaat militants, and RISF personnel. Additional casualties include members of local Animist groups, Dutch militia units funded by the government, and smaller numbers of fighters affiliated with the Christendom of Romariia and the newly discovered Muslim militia, both of whom were reportedly present in limited engagements, but have not yet been confirmed to be true. There have been rumors that Socialist International Troops were also involved, but these have not been confirmed to be true.

Deaths and casualties caused by the Yoshis, however, have exceeded hundreds of thousands, as the stampedes have spread beyond Yoshiland, some spreading out from Romariia and into Socialist international, with estimates starting from 10,000 to over 100,000 in Romariia. There are reports of Yoshi casualties; however, these casualties are smaller.

Injuries by both factions and Yoshis are estimated to be in the hundreds of thousands so far, with hospitals across nearby regions overwhelmed, and some being damaged and destroyed by both the factions and the Yoshis. Civilian displacement has also reached extreme levels, with entire communities fleeing the province as fighting continues to spread.

Yoshilands small size and geographic position between the Nedreland and Romariia Federal Groups has contributed to the scale of the chaos, with limited escape routes compounding both human and animal movement.

Government response has so far been limited. With military forces stretched across multiple internal crises and facing external threats, especially from Wuloosya, authorities have struggled to re-establish control over the province and control over the Yoshi stampedes, especially since the conflict is still ongoing.

There are suggestions in the government to deploy the Romariian Ground Forces (RGF).

More information is expected to be released later due to this conflict being new.

THE GOVERNMENT HAS DECLARED MARTIAL LAW IN YOSHILAND PROVINCE.

[/spoiler]
